conviction_note: The one company-level item is a likely upward step in the Feb-2027 / new Aug-2027 DPU guide. The ¥29.4bn Toyosu Prime Square purchase closed 2026-09-30, and management's own target is 'DPU年率3%+α'. That item is small and probably expected, because this REIT beats and raises routinely: Feb-26 DPU went 2,380 to 2,414 actual, Aug-26 2,400 to 2,450. It also sold its last beat-and-raise (-1.69%, -0.87 vs the REIT ETF on 2026-04-22). So p_up is 55 on an abs move of 1.3 (proxy 1.04, lifted because a new period's guide comes with the print), which scales to +0.13 against a findings sum of +0.30. The gap is the sell-the-raise record and a weak REIT tape (-5.8% ETF over 20 days) acting on p_up only.
bar: Company forecast for the Aug-2026 period (49th): DPU ¥2,450, net income ¥14,606m, from the 2026年2月期 決算短信, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260421/140120260421507261.pdf. Reaffirmed with no revision on 2026-08-26 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260826/140120260826526421.pdf, section 8). No IFIS or 四季報 DPU consensus could be sourced, so the market's own number is unsourced and the guidance findings are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% (no disclosed position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-21 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, per the baseline). 信用倍率 328x (kabutan stock page https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=8954, read 2026-10-22), so margin longs are crowded and the margin short side is negligible. No squeeze fuel, and some overhang if the print disappoints. No options or skew exist in Japan. priced_lean_pct -0.95, driven by margin overhang. Run-up: -6.25% over 20 days and -1.78% over 5, against a REIT ETF (1343) down about 5.8% over the same 20 days, so the fall is mostly sector and rates, not company-specific.

findings.finding: The Feb-2027 DPU forecast of ¥2,450 was set in April without Toyosu Prime Square: ¥29.4bn, appraisal NOI yield 3.7%, 3.3% after depreciation, acquired 2026-09-30 inside the Feb-2027 period and debt-funded. That forecast also leaned on an ¥805m reserve drawdown (about ¥146 a unit), and the asset manager's stated goal is DPU growth of 3% a year plus α. So this print, which must also issue a first Aug-2027 forecast, is more likely to raise the forward DPU path (toward roughly ¥2,480-2,520) than to hold it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-21 (15:30): acquisitions plus a higher forward guide, then +1.08% next session against +0.80% for the REIT ETF (1343.T). 2026-04-21 (15:30): Feb-26 beat (2,414 vs 2,380) and Aug-26 guide raised 2,400 to 2,450, then -1.69% against -0.82% for the ETF. Raises have been bought weakly or sold.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced. The acquisition and its yield have been public since 2026-08-26, and the company then said no forecast revision, so the market has not been handed a DPU number. If a raise were fully priced, the stock should have held up against the sector. Instead it fell with the REIT ETF (-6.25% vs about -5.8%) and shows no relative strength into the print. The size stays small because this name raises routinely and the raise is the expected outcome.
findings.independence: The forecast and its reserve-drawdown assumption come from the April 決算短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260421/140120260421507261.pdf). The habit of raising comes from the Oct-2025 決算短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251021/140120251021576479.pdf: Feb-26 2,380 and Aug-26 2,400, later 2,414 actual and 2,450). All are company documents, so they are one issuer's record, not independent confirmation of the market's expectation.

findings.finding: Aug-2026 (49th period) DPU will likely print slightly above the ¥2,450 forecast. Each of the last two periods came in at or above the forecast set six months earlier (Feb-26: 2,414 actual vs 2,380), and the Hamamatsu Act Tower first-tranche gain (sale ¥17.15bn in total vs ¥14.7bn appraisal) is already inside this period's plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A reported-period beat of about 1.4% (Feb-26) came with -1.69% on 2026-04-22. The reported period has not moved this name on its own.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. A J-REIT's current-period DPU sits inside the guided range, any excess is often sent to the 圧縮積立金 reserve rather than paid out, and holders expect a small beat. It is filed at near zero for that reason.
findings.independence: The Apr-2026 決算短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260421/140120260421507261.pdf) shows the Feb-26 actual of 2,414 against the earlier 2,380 forecast. Same issuer.

findings.finding: The Feb-2027 forecast already shows ordinary profit -12.9% period on period, because the Aug-26 sale gain rolls off. kabutan's automated headline for each Aug-FY J-REIT this month has read '今期経常は○%減益へ', and peers split on it: Nomura Real Estate Master Fund (3462) fell 4.58% vs -0.36% for the ETF after its 10-16 release, while GLP (3281, +0.70%) and Mitsui Fudosan Accommodations (3226, +1.01%) rose.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name's own April-2026 headline read '今期経常は1%増で3期連続最高益更新へ' and the stock still fell 1.69%. No own instance of a 減益 headline on record.
findings.why_not_priced: The profit decline is in the April forecast, so it is public. What is not public is how the release frames it. The peer evidence is mixed (one down, two up), so this is a proxy kept near zero.
findings.independence: Peer releases: GLP https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3281&b=k202610150119 (2026-10-15) and MFA https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3226&b=k202610200003 (2026-10-20). Both went the other way, which is why this is sized at about zero.
